name: MonaCoin
classificationNote: Upstream label "Bridge & Cross-Chain / Forged Proof" on a base-layer chain: reclassified as a 51%/consensus attack.
rootCause: On May 18, a Reddit netizen posted that Monacoin suffered a 51% computing power attack, a selfish mining attack, and a time stamp attack. The exact time occurred from May 13 to May 15. Some exchanges that support Monacoin trading, such as Bittrex, Livecoin have closed Monacoin recharge.

descriptions.text: On May 18, a Reddit netizen posted that Monacoin suffered a 51% computing power attack, a selfish mining attack, and a time stamp attack. The exact time occurred from May 13 to May 15. Some exchanges that support Monacoin trading, such as Bittrex, Livecoin have closed Monacoin recharge.

Between May 13 and 15, 2018, Monacoin suffered a 51% attack that allowed a malicious mining pool to double-spend coins by manipulating block confirmations. Approximately $90,000 in MONA was withdrawn from exchanges before detection. The attack exploited a weakness in Monacoin’s difficulty retargeting algorithm, but no protocol or code patch was immediately deployed. A flaw in Monacoin's mining difficulty retargeting logic enabled a mining pool with majority hashrate to rapidly mine and withhold blocks, privately extending the chain and enabling double-spend attacks against exchanges.
